title: Hezekiah Seeks Isaiah's Help

questions.question: As soon as King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes and covered himself with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:1 (ESV): "he tore his clothes and covered himself with sackcloth"

questions.question: He went into the house of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:1 (ESV): "and went into the house of the LORD."

questions.question: Hezekiah prayed to the LORD: "O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, enthroned above the what?"
Whom have you mocked and reviled? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes haughtily? Against the Holy One of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:23 (ESV): "Against the Holy One of Israel!"

questions.question: And the angel of the LORD went out and struck down how many in the camp of the Assyrians?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:36 (ESV): "struck down 185,000 in the camp of the Assyrians."

questions.question: This day is a day of distress, of rebuke, and of disgrace; children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:3 (ESV): "and there is no strength to bring them forth."

questions.question: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, so that he shall hear a rumor and return to his own land, and I will make him fall by the what in his own land?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:7 (ESV): "and I will make him fall by the sword in his own land."

questions.question: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it; and Hezekiah went up to the house of the LORD and did what with it?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:14 (ESV): "and spread it before the LORD."

questions.question: Because you have raged against me and your complacency has come to my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:29 (ESV): "and my bit in your mouth,"

questions.question: For out of Jerusalem shall go a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:32 (ESV): "and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors."

questions.question: Sennacherib king of Assyria departed and went home and lived at where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:37 (ESV): "went home and lived at Nineveh."

questions.question: And as he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, who struck him down with the sword?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:38 (ESV): "Adrammelech and Sharezer, his sons, struck him down with the sword."

questions.question: Which king of Cush came out to fight against Sennacherib?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:9 (ESV): "he heard concerning Tirhakah king of Cush,"

questions.question: He shall not come into this city or shoot an arrow there or come before it with a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:33 (ESV): "or come before it with a shield"

questions.question: Or cast up a what against it?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 37:33 (ESV): "or cast up a siege mound against it."

key_verse_text: For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for the sake of my servant David.
